Связь VION с голосовым помощником NIKA:: Links VION with the voice assistant NIKA: finds NIKA on the home network, connects her with a code she says aloud, says VION's alarms in her voice and carries out her commands, such as «give him one more hour», with a parent's permission.
Connected and found on the home network.
Choose a NIKA found on the network, or g: Choose a NIKA found on the network, or give her address. She says a code of 6 digits aloud: enter it here.
VION and this NIKA forget each other; to: VION and this NIKA forget each other; to link them again, connect her again.
When someone tells NIKA to give a child: When someone tells NIKA to give a child more time. NIKA cannot tell a parent from a child by voice alone.
